checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Speaker is recognizably the curly-haired woman from the portrait
must.why: Same face, hair, sweater and park background; slight drift in skin tone and face shape but clearly her.

must.item: Complete script spoken exactly, no extra words
must.why: Audio not transcribed. The 5 s length is tight for the whole script.

must.item: Mouth visibly moves in sync with speech
must.why: Mouth shapes change across frames (open smile, small 'o', pursed lips), so she is clearly talking. Exact sync cannot be checked.

must.item: One square, 8-second video with audible, friendly female English speech
must.why: The clip is square (640x640) and has sound, but it is 5 s, not 8 s. Voice and language cannot be judged.
No text overlays in any frame.

exact_text.text: Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.
exact_text.read_as: No captions or on-screen text visible; spoken words cannot be verified.

faults.what: Clip is 5 s, not the 8 s the must-have asks for. The platform's free-plan limit caused this, but the result still falls short of the spec.
An unrequested waving hand appears at the end. It is slightly blurry and its fingers look a bit smeared.
The face drifts a little across the clip: skin looks warmer and the face is slightly bigger and moves toward the camera. The pursed-lips frame at 3.5 s looks a little odd.
The 5 s length may cut off or rush the full three-sentence script. This cannot be verified.

summary: A square talking video of the same woman with visible mouth movement and no captions; it runs only 5 s instead of 8 s, adds an unrequested wave, and the spoken words cannot be verified.
